scope: One calibrated panel; one-digit scores and explicit mmss/mss/seconds_tenths layouts. No cross-board claim.
geometry: Original RGB, bilinear panel rectification to template reference size, then contiguous whole-field crop. No colour masks, digit concatenation, OCR-dependent trim or resize. Engine preprocessing must be separately recorded.
verification_policy: Lock by whole recording, never adjacent-frame random splits. Original/live/controlled are OCR development; monitor recapture is OCR configuration verification only. All four are known region-reader development/regression footage on this panel, not unseen-board or independent-baseline validation. Do not inspect new OCR output on the verification recording until settings are frozen; tuning retires it to development. True board/session holdout deferred to task 5.

metric_rules.accounting: Use audit_readings counters, per engine/recording/field/split/window; never pool unreadable with wrong or unreviewed with correct. Held matching values are not fresh success.
metric_rules.temporal: Run full source history from zero, never restart state at review windows. Age uses source time, stale age >=1s. Duration = count of held stale source-grid samples/fps. Confirmation delay starts at the first reviewed clearly readable sample after a value change or unavailable run; recovery starts after unavailable input. Require a complete reviewed sequence through confirmation; otherwise right-censored, never zero. Report source-grid delay separately from wall-time latency.
metric_rules.runtime: One isolated streaming Mac worker, all three fields; model-only and full pipeline separately, include decode/crop/parse/state boundaries and backend/precision/thread settings. 10 source fps and 100ms per sample provisional; not hardware-to-OBS latency.
metric_rules.synthetic: Generated clean labels separate from physical footage. Mixtures have no physical truth; count third-digit observations/fresh confirmations separately, including preserved blurred failures. Use exposure_stress source hash and declared matrix, never assign old/new mixture truth.

gates.rule: No new wrong fresh readable confirmation versus frozen region baseline at any reviewed sample; a new per-sample error fails even if aggregate count falls.
No additional fresh confirmation on reviewed unreadable fields versus frozen region baseline, compared per sample; report retained baseline risks separately.
Retain correct fresh output where baseline confirms reviewed clean score anchors; no wrong raw clean-score observations. Report unavailable regressions explicitly.

At least one reproducible coverage/recovery benefit with paired counts and examples and no correctness-gate regression; portability deferred until new-board evidence. Mixed benefit permits at most one bounded follow-up, not automatic promotion.
Measure isolated three-field throughput against provisional 10Hz budget, memory/startup/dependencies/setup. Misses require an explicit feasibility decision, never conceal backlog as freshness.

result_schema.missing_evidence: Explicit null plus reason; never zero or pass. Native confidence is diagnostic, not probability or cross-engine comparable.

output_policy: Offline diagnostic only; no camera/server/OBS integration or output promotion.
